text:
Maya (Product): Quick design review for the Private setup wizard - concentrating on error messaging, copy for CIDR/egress, and accessibility fixes. Want to avoid modal-heavy flows.
Michael (Design): Suggest inline expandable error details instead of modal. Rename 'External IP' to 'Egress IP(s) (optional)'. Also let's move 'Validate network' next to the field and show a small spinner/chip.
Srini (Eng): Backend will provide a preflight id and per-step statuses. We should make network tests cancellable and backoff retries. For parsing: accept comma/space/newline separated CIDRs and strip whitespace.
Jia (DevEx): Accessibility notes: helper text should have aria-describedby; status chip must update an aria-live region. Color contrast for warning needs to be >=4.5:1. Keyboard users expect stepper to focus on next step header when skipping.
Alex (Support): From support tickets: customers often paste a single IP and wonder if they should include ports. Let's add helper: 'Enter IPs only (no ports). Ports are listed below with recommended direction.'
Maya (Product): Microcopy for CIDR helper: 'CIDR ranges (example: 10.0.0.0/16). Multiple ranges allowed, separated by commas or newlines.' For skip CTA: 'Skip and validate later — preflight required before creating a private deployment.'
Michael (Design): I'll prototype a condensed ports table: port | direction | why. Keep rows collapsed by default and add 'show more' for protocol details.
Srini (Eng): Provide copyable commands for customers:
```
# health check
curl -sfS https://private.redwood.example/health || echo "failed"
# tcp probe
nc -vz private.redwood.example 443
```
One-click copy is essential.
Jia (DevEx): We'll add anchors in docs for each step and a terraform snippet for common VPC shapes. Also link the 'why we ask' to docs side panel.
Maya (Product): Decision: inline chips for status, non-blocking validation, clear copy updates, and required aria-live updates. I'll update the spec and share updated Figma.
Michael (Design): tagging @Jia for aria placements. Will push figma update.
Srini (Eng): I'll have the preflight API PR by Tuesday.
Alex (Support): Thanks, will update our KB with the new copy and the troubleshooting curl/nc snippets.
